steps.caption: VPN Shield
steps.narration: This is VPN Shield. It checks each visit to your website for signs of a VPN or proxy.

steps.caption: What it does now
steps.narration: The top line says what it does right now. On this site, flagged visitors see a blocking overlay.

steps.caption: Detections, blocked, unique IPs
steps.narration: Overview counts all detections, today's, how many were blocked, and the unique VPN addresses.

steps.caption: Where the traffic came from
steps.narration: Top VPN providers shows the kind of network behind the flagged visits.

steps.caption: Every flagged visit
steps.narration: Flagged visits lists each one: the IP, how it was detected, and the action taken.

steps.caption: A data center address
steps.narration: This visit came from a data center address, so the visitor saw the blocking overlay.

steps.caption: The visit's details
steps.narration: Open one for the full record.

steps.caption: Browser, location, landing page
steps.narration: Next to the detection details are the browser, the location, the landing page and the referrer.

steps.caption: Its own script tag
steps.narration: Install script has the tag to paste into your site. It's separate from the Click Guard code.

steps.caption: Block, log or redirect
steps.narration: In Settings, you choose the response: Log only, Block, or Redirect to a page you pick.

steps.caption: Start with Log only
steps.narration: New sites start in Log only, so you can look at the detections before you block anyone.

steps.caption: Addresses you trust
steps.narration: List the addresses you trust, like your office, one per line, and they're never blocked.

steps.caption: Search engines pass
steps.narration: Googlebot, Bingbot and other known crawlers are let through.

steps.caption: Menu: VPN Shield
steps.narration: You'll find VPN Shield in the menu on the left, under Tools.

youtube.title: VPN Shield in about a minute | ConstructHUB
youtube.description: A one-minute tour of VPN Shield in ConstructHUB: how many visits to your website show signs of a VPN or proxy, each flagged visit with how it was detected and the action taken, and the settings to block, log or redirect them, with a whitelist for the addresses you trust.
